title: refactor: resolve effective community listing state
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Resolves matured visibility and pricing changes as one effective proxy-listing state
- Reuses that state in catalog generation, account responses, updates, and fallback validation
- Preserves newer credentials and fallback settings when delayed pricing matures
- Tests the delay boundary and existing account/API behavior

gist.headline: The listings remember
gist.blurb: Community model listings now resolve their grown-up visibility and pricing changes in one place. Polli kept the fresh credentials and fallback settings safely in the hive instead of letting a delayed price update shuffle them away.
gist.summary: Community proxy listings now compute matured visibility and pricing changes as one effective state, reused by catalogs, account responses, update handling, and fallback validation while preserving newer credentials and fallback settings.
gist.impact: Users and API clients get consistent community model listings at the pricing-delay boundary, without newer credentials or fallback configuration being overwritten by a maturing update.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy community-model garden where one central listing card blooms into its final visibility-and-price state while attached key and fallback-setting tags remain safely pinned in place. Polli, wearing a tiny librarian visor, carefully organizes the card beside a retro terminal; small code-plants and a clock at the delay boundary represent the newly unified effective-state logic.
